firstOccurrence.englishText: Then the border shall go to Ziphron, and it shall end at Hazar Enan. This shall be your north border.

timeline.evidenceText: Then the border shall go to Ziphron, and it shall end at Hazar Enan. This shall be your north border.
“ ‘You shall mark out your east border from Hazar Enan to Shepham.

“Now these are the names of the tribes: From the north end, beside the way of Hethlon to the entrance of Hamath, Hazar Enan at the border of Damascus, northward beside Hamath (and they shall have their sides east and west), Dan, one portion.
